name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Financial inclusion scheme providing access to basic banking services.
eligibility: Eligible citizens meeting the scheme requirements.
benefits: Basic banking access and related financial inclusion benefits.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Scheme supporting eligible households with LPG connections.
eligibility: Eligible households as defined by the current scheme guidelines.
benefits: LPG connection support and applicable assistance.

name: PM-KISAN
description: Income support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families.
eligibility: Eligible farmer families under current PM-KISAN rules.
benefits: Financial support subject to scheme rules.

name: Uttar Pradesh Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement
description: State portal for eligible students to apply for scholarship and fee reimbursement schemes.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the applicable scholarship category and current state rules.
